notes.title: Park Ranger Demo | Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157216/7fa0d0052a6dd63d1f28faa7a6889cc66e84cb7f.jpg"]



We’ve just rolled out a small update to the Park Ranger demo!



Enhanced shading for a more vibrant and colorful look

Improved driving physics for a smoother, more realistic feel



We'll keep you up-to-date on all the updates we implement for the demo and thank you for being part of the journey! 💚
